title: Space Force to prototype new software to fuse commercial, military space tracking data
summary: The U.S. Space Force plans to prototype new software aimed at fusing commercial and military space tracking data. This initiative is a top priority for Space Force Mission Delta 2, led by Col. Barry Crocker. The goal is to enhance support for space control operations and improve the monitoring of on-orbit threats.

title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
summary: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company has received conditional approval for a national trust bank charter from the OCC. This approval enables Bastion to offer federally regulated services including stablecoin custody, wallets, payment infrastructure, and white-label issuance. It marks a significant step towards integrating digital asset services within traditional banking regulations.

title: Coinbase Files to List Single-Stock Perps on Apple, Tesla and Nvidia
summary: Coinbase has filed with the CFTC to list single-stock perpetual futures for major companies like Apple, Tesla, and Nvidia. These proposed contracts would offer US traders 24/5 leveraged exposure to individual stocks without requiring direct ownership. The filing represents a significant move to expand crypto-adjacent trading products in the US market.

title: Solana's Heartbeat Quickens: Block Times Fall 17% in Latest Speed Upgrade
summary: Solana has implemented a new speed upgrade, resulting in a 17% reduction in block times. This enhancement improves the network's transaction freshness, although it does not directly increase overall capacity. The quicker block times contribute to faster finality and a more responsive user experience on the network.

title: Robinhood Chain fees collapse 97% even as transactions stay near record highs
